answer: Join slots follow one global price ledger: the k-th slot sold in an epoch costs 10 + 2k tokens, paid into a burn vault, so an attacker who wants to forge 100 identities in one epoch pays about 11,100 while an honest agent pays 12. The slot counter is an ember that cools by 10 percent per epoch. Cheapest bypass: join one per epoch for 100 epochs, which cuts the bill to about 2,800, still 28 per identity, and only works for an attacker who can wait.
